_comment: Awin shops of Construction Gear World for the shared import and the Hub's shadow catalogue (31 Oct 2026, phase 4 of 'every product through the Hub'). The general rules are in sites/_shared/construction-rules.js; a shop here can set: denyPaths (sections that belong to another Gear World: garden and car tools), allowPaths (only these sections, lessons L65, taken from the sections of the products the site showed on 31 Oct 2026), sectionHints (false, or the top sections whose names may place a product), defaultCategory (a shop whose names do not say the type: Nebo torches, GRABO lifters). UK programmes only (L87): Reidl (DE) and VEVOR NL are still on the site from the older import but are not offered here; InStock UK is no longer a joined programme. GS Workwear sends a Google Shopping file saved in Downloads as 48473-*.csv.gz. The older per-shop import rules (tools/import-rules/) still load this site until the shared import replaces them.
